title: ON–VEHICLE INSPECTION
ocr_text:
BO–42
BODY – SPORT ROOF

ON–VEHICLE INSPECTION

INSPECT REMOVABLE ROOF PANEL ALIGNMENT
(a) With the removable roof installed, check for water leakage.
(b) Check for a difference in clearance and level between the removable roof panel and roof panel.
Clearance:
    Front side: 6.0±1.5 mm (0.236±0.06 in.)
    Rear side: 6.0±1.5 mm (0.236±0.06 in.)
Level: (Rear side)
    RH/LH side: +1.5 —2.0 mm (+0.06—-0.08 in.)
    Center: +1.0—2.0 mm (+0.04—-0.08 in.)
    Zero level: upper surface of roof panel

REMOVABLE ROOF ADJUSTMENT
1. REMOVE ROOF HEADLINING
(a) Removable roof headlining – for clearance adjustment (See pages BO–41 and 61)
(b) Rear roof headlining – for level adjustment (See pages BO–58 to 61)
